_comment: Every tool that declares reach anyone, with the reason it is safe: the in-code guard it relies on (callers list, presence proof, own-scope check, held at the Gate), or read-only. A tool with a mutating verb in its name needs a reason that names a guard; read-only does not count. PENDING reasons are tracked and shrink. test/reach-anyone.test.js fails on an anyone with no entry.

github.session.history.reason: read-only: a session's own commits and uncommitted count; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects

github.session.push.reason: guard: pushes only the session's own vyre/<id> branch, by explicit refspec, never forced, to the project's recorded repo from a throwaway repo that reads none of the project's git config; the outgoing commits are secret-scanned and allow_secret counts only for a person or a call the person's words asked for; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects

github.session.redo.reason: guard: restores only what github.session.undo saved for that session, refused when the branch moved on; never touches the default branch or a remote; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects

github.session.undo.reason: guard: acts only on the session's own worktree and branch; nothing is deleted (the tip and unsaved work are kept under a ref and github.session.redo restores them); never touches the default branch or a remote; the project-grant check (inGrant) bounds an agent to its granted projects
